description:
Poll for text changes on official regulator pages since your last poll.

    Radar Watch keeps a durable log of every detected change to the
    registry-owned official sources (SEC, European Commission, EFRAG, CARB).
    Pass the `cursor` from your previous answer as `since` to receive only
    what is new; 0 returns the whole log for your selection. Each change has
    the source, both text hashes, the detection time and a short diff
    excerpt. The answer lists exactly which sources were watched and when
    they were last retrieved, plus the curated deadline calendar. Sources are
    re-retrieved when the last sweep is older than `max_age_hours`. A change
    is a text difference on an official page, not a legal determination.

    Example arguments: {"jurisdiction": "california", "since": 0}

jurisdiction.description: Where the company operates, for example california, us, eu or uk.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

max_age_hours.description: Optional. Refresh the sources if the last sweep is older. 1 to 168, default 24.
max_age_hours.title: Max Age Hours

payment_ref.description: Optional. A paid credit or payment reference, used only after the free daily calls. Leave it out to use the free tier or a seat.
payment_ref.title: Payment Ref

request_id.description: Optional. Your id for this call. Repeat it to retry safely: the same request_id is never charged twice.
request_id.title: Request Id

since.description: The cursor from your previous answer. 0 for everything.
since.title: Since

topics.description: Optional. Topics to keep, for example ["ghg", "scope 3"].
topics.title: Topics

name: watch_changes
title: Watch changes
